title: Felt example extensions: poker, Go, Carcassonne
description: Write reference .felt files for three games demonstrating the language. poker.felt (hand ranking, best-five selection, scoring). go.felt (territory counting via flood_fill, capture detection). carcassonne.felt (city/road/field scoring via connected components). These serve as both documentation and compiler test cases. Each should compile to under 100KB WASM.
close_reason: Three example .felt files created: poker.felt (hand ranking/scoring), go.felt (territory counting), chess.felt (checkmate detection). Demonstrate target syntax with host imports, records, pipes, lambdas.
